claim_text: An independently defined SPP1+TAM state is associated with colorectal cancer liver metastasis across public cohorts
required_evidence: Discovery cohort; independent validation; sample-level differential abundance

claim_text: Published CRLM-associated myeloid states have testable and unequal cross-cohort transportability, allowing patient-level evidence synthesis to distinguish broadly reproducible programs from context-specific or unsupported labels
biological_unit: Patient or independent sample within cohort; independent study for synthesis
required_evidence: Non-overlapping cohorts; frozen state panel; patient-level effect estimates; heterogeneity and leave-one-study-out analyses; orthogonal spatial validation
claim_ceiling: Associational transportability, heterogeneity and spatial localization

claim_text: A preregistered subset of immune programs can be externally classified as more malignancy-linked or more liver-niche-linked across independent CRC primary and liver-metastasis cohorts
required_evidence: Discovery classifier; at least two non-overlapping matched external cohorts; domain-shift audit; patient-level validation
claim_ceiling: Associational ecological alignment; no ontogeny or causality

claim_text: Macrophage-program changes after neoadjuvant PD-1 therapy in dMMR CRC are associated with treatment and pathological response in paired biological samples
biological_unit: Patient with paired or otherwise explicitly modeled samples
required_evidence: Usable pairing; arm and response labels; patient-level treatment model; non-overlapping validation
